newsitem.title: USA: LCI Intl to offer $300 mln senior notes.
newsitem.headline: LCI Intl to offer $300 mln senior notes.

text.p: LCI International Telecom Corp said Wednesday it plans a public offering of $300 million of senior notes under its omnibus shelf registration statement.
LCI said it intends to use the proceeds to repay borrowings under its revolving credit facility, for working capital and general corporate purposes, and to support continued anticipated growth.
The underwriting will be led by Lehman Brothers and includes Goldman Sachs & Co, Merrill Lynch & Co and NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc as co-managers, LCI said.
